name: Martian Civil War
description: Artillery duel on a dying Mars — Red Martians against Green. Crew an assault platform (a building on wheels) and trade broadsides across fully destructible terrain: arc over the ridge, or bore a tunnel through it and fire down the corridor. Every mount you own fires each turn; an armory of permanent weapon mounts plus hull, shield and drive modules; wind, fuel-driven repositioning, and an enemy gunner that ranges you better as the campaign goes on.
